criteria.assessment: The task correctly resolves requested committed blobs to one full SHA and discovers live/archive/current/gitless records. The checkout-local parked-card inventory violates source-root confinement when .later itself is an external directory symlink: outside Markdown titles are read and returned as local paths. The accepted safety and source attribution requirement is not adequately covered by the existing direct-file-symlink fixture.

unit.assessment: WB-source-errors verifies traversal and direct committed symlink rejection, but does not challenge ancestor directory symlinks in the filesystem inventory path; the actual external-directory counterexample leaks title text.

integration.assessment: WB-snapshot exercises pinned revision bytes and refresh semantics. WB-inventory verifies current/task/archive/gitless/parked categories, but its ordinary .later directory cannot discriminate source-root escape and false checkout-local attribution.

tests.assertion_assessment: Assertions check task-branch current work, a live ref, default-branch archive, missing-model discovery, parked-card exclusion from workstreams, detached context and gitless fallback. The parked-card fixture lacks an ancestor symlink and therefore passes despite reading titles outside the checkout.
tests.counterexample: Create an external temporary directory containing secret.md with header External private title; symlink checkout/.later to it. discover_work returns slug secret, that external title, and path .later/secret.md. This violates checkout-local source attribution and confinement while all current assertions pass.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Valid red run 5aaefa45ffdc4d50a057bb88c8ae150d fails this selector by behavior_assertion at fb3bb24cc0a893c8af47e8014055da09d9beee55; current candidate green 6a149709396442fe8a841ee8e433d613 passes. Mapped source bytes are identical between red and green. Valid continuity does not cover the missing ancestor-symlink counterexample. No exemption.

tests.assertion_assessment: Assertions bind model, graph, plan and requested source to the first captured full commit, preserve the captured bytes after ref movement, permit a new snapshot only on explicit reread, and expose editable=false. The implementation uses read-only Git commands and no publication/edit path.
tests.counterexample: A reader that resolves the moving ref independently for each blob can mix revision 1 model and revision 2 source; a refreshed read that mutates the original capture fails the retained REVISION=1 assertion. The test could be strengthened by capturing HEAD/refs/files before the initial read instead of afterward.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Valid red run 5aaefa45ffdc4d50a057bb88c8ae150d fails the captured full-commit assertion; exact-candidate green 6a149709396442fe8a841ee8e433d613 passes with unchanged mapped assertion source. No exemption.

tests.assertion_assessment: Missing optional blobs, traversal paths, direct committed outside symlinks and missing model are explicitly diagnosed/rejected. Those checks correctly protect Git blob reads but do not establish confinement for inventory reads through an external .later directory symlink.
tests.counterexample: A parent-directory symlink makes each regular Markdown child pass path.is_file and not path.is_symlink; reading its heading exposes external content despite the direct-file-symlink test passing. Add a source-root/ancestor-path assertion for filesystem inventory reads.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: Valid red run 5aaefa45ffdc4d50a057bb88c8ae150d fails this selector by behavior_assertion; exact-candidate green 6a149709396442fe8a841ee8e433d613 passes. The earlier run 29bba382314d4f2a920fe6322605669d is explicitly excluded as runtime-error history. No exemption.

findings.assessment: Resolve and confine the .later directory and each candidate card to the supplied repository root before reading title text; direct path.is_symlink checks do not protect ancestor directories.

limitations: SourceSnapshot is a raw committed byte container, not a validated Engineering Model admission. Downstream selected-source validation must use the existing document layer before consumption; editable=false does not establish validation.
No coordinator recording or integration was performed.
